prompt:
3:4，自然光数码古装写真，粉白古装 × 深色木质回廊 × 强烈庭院日光 × 高光溢出 × 深暗背景 × 清甜灵动

人物为成年女性；轻盈纤细，漂亮自然，黑色长发半束高髻，粉珠银链额饰、白花与粉白羽毛头饰、银色长链耳坠；淡粉半哑光妆容。

服装固定：
粉白长裙 / 淡粉胸前拼片 / 白色半透明宽袖薄纱 / 浅粉披帛，轻薄透光材质。

【场景】
木柱旁 / 雕花门边 / 回廊栏杆内侧 / 廊道入口 / 格窗旁 / 门槛边

【事件动作】
托着白兔观察 / 抚摸兔耳 / 从柱后探身 / 抬手展开披帛 / 双手牵起薄纱观察透光 / 扶柱探头 / 整理耳边发丝 / 靠栏向外看 / 提裙跨门槛 / 转身时披帛被风带起

【表情】
好奇 / 忍笑 / 轻微惊讶 / 若有所思 / 刚准备开口 / 嘴角轻扬 / 短暂走神

【视线】
看兔子 / 看手中薄纱 / 看向画外 / 沿回廊远望 / 偶尔看向镜头后的某个人

【景别构图】
环境大半身 / 半身 / 胸像近景 / 3/4侧面 / 木柱前景遮挡 / 门框框景 / 人物偏置构图 / 大片暗色建筑负空间

【光线】
人物位于回廊阳光与阴影交界处，强烈侧前方自然日光；脸部明亮但保留五官，白纱与浅粉织物局部自然过曝，深色木质建筑明显欠曝，暗部接近黑色，不进行HDR式提亮。

【成片】
真实自然光数码写真，偏高反差，柔和肤色，轻微高光溢出，不过度锐化，非棚拍，非现代商业古风写真。

promptTranslations.en:
3:4, natural light digital period costume portrait photography, pink and white period costume × dark wooden corridor × intense courtyard daylight × blown-out highlight bloom × deep dark background × sweet and lively

Subject is an adult female; lithe and slender, naturally beautiful, long black hair half-tied in a high bun, forehead ornament with pink beads and silver chains, white flowers and pinkish-white feather headdress, long silver chain earrings; soft pink semi-matte makeup.

Fixed Attire:
Pink and white long skirt / pale pink chest patch / white translucent wide-sleeved sheer gauze / light pink pibo scarf, lightweight and translucent material.

[Scene]
Beside a wooden pillar / next to a carved wooden door / inside the corridor railing / corridor entrance / beside a latticed window / by the threshold

[Action / Movement]
Holding a white rabbit and observing it / stroking the rabbit's ears / leaning out from behind a pillar / raising hands to spread the scarf / lifting the sheer gauze with both hands to observe light transmission / holding the pillar and peeking out / tucking hair behind the ear / leaning on the railing looking out / lifting skirt stepping over threshold / scarf caught by the wind while turning around

[Expression]
Curious / suppressing a smile / slight surprise / thoughtful / just about to speak / slight upward curve of the lips / briefly daydreaming

[Gaze]
Looking at the rabbit / looking at the sheer fabric in hand / looking outside the frame / gazing into the distance along the corridor / occasionally looking at someone behind the camera

[Shot Framing & Composition]
Environmental three-quarter shot / medium shot / bust close-up / 3/4 profile / wooden pillar foreground occlusion / doorframe framing / off-center character composition / large areas of dark architectural negative space

[Lighting]
The subject is situated at the boundary between sunlight and shadow in the corridor, strong natural daylight from the front-side; face is bright yet retains facial features, white gauze and light pink fabrics naturally overexposed in parts, dark wooden architecture noticeably underexposed, shadows near black, no HDR-style brightening.

[Final Look]
Realistic natural light digital portrait photography, slightly high contrast, soft skin tones, subtle highlight bloom, not over-sharpened, not studio-shot, not modern commercial period-costume portrait photography.

summaryTranslations.en: High-contrast natural light portrait photography prompt of a woman in pink and white traditional Chinese costume in a dark wooden corridor courtyard, including attire, scene, and action details.

summaryEn: Prompt for natural-light high-contrast portraits of a woman in pink-white traditional costume along a wooden corridor.

translations.en:
3:4, natural light digital period costume portrait, pink and white traditional dress × dark wooden corridor × intense courtyard sunlight × highlight bloom × deep dark background × sweet and lively.

Subject: adult female, slender, delicate, natural beauty, long black hair in a half-up bun, forehead ornament with pink beads and silver chains, white flowers and pinkish-white feather headdress, long silver chain earrings, subtle pink semi-matte makeup.

Attire:
Pink-and-white long gown, light pink chest patchwork, white translucent wide-sleeve chiffon, pale pink drape scarf, airy and sheer fabric.

Scene:
Beside wooden pillars, carved doors, corridor railings, corridor entrance, lattice windows, door threshold.

Actions:
Holding or petting a white rabbit, peeking from behind a pillar, raising arm to spread the scarf, holding up gauze to see light filtration, touching hair, leaning on railing, lifting skirt over threshold, turning around with scarf catching the wind.

Expressions & Gaze:
Curious, suppressing a smile, slightly surprised, pensive, smiling subtly; looking at rabbit, looking at scarf, gazing off-camera, or looking toward the lens.

Composition & Lighting:
Medium to close-up shots, 3/4 profile, wooden pillar foreground, framing, dark negative space. Located at light-shadow boundary with strong side sunlight, luminous face, natural overexposure on sheer fabrics, underexposed dark wood background, high contrast natural portrait look.
